入场.title: Enter
入场.intro: How elements appear. By default they animate from a "pre-entry" state back to the element's own look, so any CSS position or rotation you set on the element is preserved.

退场.title: Exit
退场.intro: How elements leave. Usually written as `@-0.4` (0.4 s before the scene ends).

强调.title: Emphasis
强调.intro: For elements already on screen: emphasize them when the narration reaches them. Also covers movement, color changes and content swaps.

数据.title: Data
数据.intro: Numbers, progress and charts. Number effects automatically keep decimal places and thousands separators.

镜头.title: Camera
镜头.intro: Applied to a whole container: push in, pan, 3D tilt, shake.

角色.title: Character
角色.intro: For stand-up portraits and little characters: switch poses, lip sync, nod, hop, walk.

组件.title: Components
组件.intro: Used together with components generated by `data-make`.

转场.title: Transitions
转场.intro: Written on the **later** scene: `<section class="scene" data-in="blur-cross(dur=0.5)">`.

catalog.heading: Effect catalog ({nFx} effects + {nTrans} transitions)
catalog.note1: This section is generated from `fx.js` by `node gen-readme.mjs`. Do not edit it by hand.
catalog.note2: All effects accept the common parameters `dur` (duration), `ease` (easing) and `stagger`; the tables below list only each effect's own parameters.

effects.fade-in: Plain fade-in, the most restrained; for subtitles and secondary notes
effects.rise-in: Slide up from below + fade in, the most versatile entrance. Param: dist=offset in px
effects.drop-in: Drop in from above + fade in; for tags and badges
effects.slide-in: Slide in from one side. Params: dir=left/right/up/down (direction of motion), dist
effects.blur-in: Blur to sharp, appearing in place; for big titles and screenshot cards
effects.blur-rise-in: Blur + slide up + fade in, the standard cinematic title entrance
effects.scale-in: Scale up from slightly smaller into place, the standard entrance for cards and images. Param: from=starting scale
effects.pop-in: Pop: scale up from small with an overshoot bounce; for callout pills, icons, checks and crosses
effects.zoom-settle: Settle from an enlarged, blurred state (like a lens snapping into focus); for opening headlines
effects.wipe-in: Reveal with a mask wipe. Param: dir=right/left/up/down (direction the wipe advances)
effects.mask-rise: Text rises from beneath an invisible baseline (mask slide-up); the strongest title feel
effects.flip-in: Flip upright around the horizontal axis (3D); for card flips and revealing question cards
effects.tilt-in: Fly in tilted with perspective (a 3D card turning to face front from the side); for UI screenshots
effects.stamp-in: Stamp: slams down from very large and shakes when it lands; for conclusions, seals, checks and crosses
effects.drop-bounce: Falls from above the frame and bounces twice on landing; for stacking objects and pixel blocks
effects.swing-in: Swings down from the top edge like a hanging sign and settles
effects.focus-in: Letter-spacing tightens from very wide + blur to sharp; common for small English titles and subtitles
effects.grow-x: Grow from 0 along the horizontal axis (bars, dividers, progress bars). Param: origin=left/center/right
effects.grow-y: Grow from 0 along the vertical axis (bar charts). Param: origin=bottom/top
effects.fan-in: A stack of cards fans out from the center to their own positions (use with each:); final positions and angles follow your CSS
effects.type: Typewriter: types out character by character. Params: cps=characters per second, caret=1 to show the cursor
effects.draw: Line drawing: an SVG stroke is drawn along its path (connectors, arrows, circled callouts, line charts)
effects.pixel-in: Pixel-style entrance: appears in 4-5 discrete steps (not smooth); with each: it can assemble block lettering
effects.scramble: Scramble decode: each character first flickers through random glyphs (gray), then locks into the correct character (white) from left to right. Params: dur, chars=pool of scramble characters
effects.rise-out: Slide up and away + fade out
effects.drop-out: Slide down and away + fade out
effects.blur-out: Blur + fade out (recedes into the background)
effects.scale-out: Shrink + fade out. Param: to=ending scale (>1 means it grows as it disappears)
effects.slide-out: Slide out to one side. Param: dir
effects.pulse: Scale up briefly and back (a tap when the narration hits this word). Param: to=peak scale
effects.shake: Shake left and right (negation, errors, warnings)
effects.nod: A small up-and-down hop (character nod, icon bounce)
effects.blink: Blink a few times (cursor, warnings). Param: n=count
effects.color: Change text / background color. Params: to=color, bg=background color
effects.marker: Highlighter: a color block sweeps left to right across the bottom of the text. Params: color, h=block height in %
effects.underline: Underline grows from left to right. Params: color, w=thickness in px
effects.strike: A strikethrough sweeps across (the old plan is void)
effects.box: Highlight box: draws an outline around the element (circle the key point on a screenshot). Params: color, pad, w, r
effects.glow: Glow breathing: the halo lights up then fades. Params: color, n=count
effects.sheen: Shine sweep: a highlight sweeps diagonally across a card / button
effects.ping: Ripple: a ring expands from the element's center (click feedback, marking a location)
effects.spot: Spotlight: use with each:; the i-th child stays bright and slightly enlarged while the rest are dimmed. Param: i (1-based)
effects.float: Continuous up-and-down floating (idle feel). Params: amp=amplitude, period=seconds per cycle, dur=how long it lasts
effects.move: Move the element to another element's position (cursor moves to a button, a tag flies into a card). Params: to=#target or x, y
effects.click: Click: press-down shrink + ripple (use with the .fx-cursor component)
effects.swap: Swap content in place: fades itself out and fades the target element in. Param: to=#target
effects.squash: Card squash-and-spring: narrows horizontally then springs back (about 3 frames squash + 4 frames spring), often used together with a content swap. Param: to=narrowest ratio
effects.cycle: Hard-cut carousel over children: one visible at a time, switching to the next every `every` seconds (a thumbnail whose picture keeps changing). Params: every, loop=1 to loop, stop=which item to stop on
effects.text: Hard-cut text to new content (clock ticks, label changes). Param: v=new text
effects.to: Universal tween: write GSAP properties directly. Example: to@2(x=120,scale=1.2,opacity=0.5,dur=0.6,ease=inout)
effects.count: Number counter. Put the final number in the element, or set it with to=; from=starting value. Automatically keeps decimal places and thousands separators
effects.roll: Digit-by-digit vertical roll: each digit is a 0-9 vertical strip that scrolls with blur and then stops from left to right (the $7,000 in the black-gold theme). Params: dur, stagger, spins=extra full turns
effects.clock: Clock dial-in: from=23:28 to to=01:23 (crosses midnight automatically)
effects.fill: Progress bar fill: grows the element's width (or height with dir=y) from from% to to%
effects.ring: Ring progress: use with data-make="ring". Params: from, to (0-1)
effects.wave-live: Waveform jumping: use with data-make="wave"; each bar fluctuates randomly from a seed. Params: dur, seed
effects.push: Slow push-in (Ken Burns): the whole container scales up slightly at constant speed over time. Params: from, to, dur
effects.pan: Slow pan. Params: x, y (total displacement in px), dur
effects.zoom-to: Zoom to a region: scales and pans the container so the target area fills the frame. Params: to=#target or x,y,w,h (px inside the container), fill=fraction of the frame
effects.zoom-reset: Pull back from a close-up to the full view
effects.tilt: Place at a 3D tilt and slowly rotate (a floating UI card). Params: rx, ry start angles; rx2, ry2 end angles
effects.drift: Slow background drift (blurred card wall, particle layer). Params: x, y, rot, dur
effects.pose: Switch character pose: put several [data-pose] images in a .host and hard-cut to the one named by name (talking-head portraits are normally hard cuts); bounce=1 adds a squash-and-spring
effects.lipsync: Lip sync: hard-cuts between several [data-mouth] images in the container every `frames` frames (usually 2-4), returning to the first when done. Params: dur, frames, seed
effects.talk: Small up-and-down bobbing while talking. Params: dur=how long it talks, rate=bobs per second
effects.hop: Hop in place (surprise, joy). Params: h=height, n=count
effects.walk: Walk over: horizontal movement + a bounce per step. Params: x=displacement or to=#target, steps=number of steps; for pixel characters add ease=steps(8)
effects.step: Step navigation switch: use with data-make="steps"; lights up the i-th pill (1-based) and turns the rest off
effects.chapter: Chapter progress bar: use with data-make="chapters"; the highlight block slides to chapter i (1-based)
effects.check: Checklist tick: use with the .fx-check component; the check mark is drawn and the text turns solid
effects.转场/push: Push: the new scene pushes the old one out. Param: dir=left/right/up/down
effects.cut: Hard cut (default). The most common and fastest-paced
effects.blur-cross: Blur cross: the previous shot blurs and fades out while the next goes from blurred to sharp
effects.zoom-through: Zoom through: the previous shot scales up and rushes out of frame while the next scales up from small into place
effects.wipe: Wipe: the new scene covers the old one along a direction. Param: dir
effects.iris: Iris: the new scene expands from a point to full screen. Params: x, y (percent)
effects.flash: Flash to white (or any color): for key sentences and chapter openings. Param: color
effects.dip: Dip to black: fades to dark then back up (change of topic). Param: color
effects.pixelate: Pixel dissolve: blocks cover the screen in random order and then disperse (scene change for the pixel style). Params: cols, color
